info.name: FitGym Membership API
info.description:
Postman collection for the FitGym gym membership system (course: Introduction to Software Engineering 2026).

Base URL: http://localhost:5116 (ASP.NET Core http profile). For https use https://localhost:7232.

Auth: this collection uses JWT Bearer tokens. After Register/Login, copy the returned token into the {{memberToken}} variable (collection-level). For Trainer / Receptionist role checks, generate a token with the same secret (FitGym_Course_Secret_Key_At_Least_32_Characters_Long_2026) and put it in {{trainerToken}} / {{receptionistToken}}.

Each request documents the expected status code and key response fields. See Wiki article 05 (Verification and Release Checklist) for the full risk-focused checklist.

request.description:
Register a new member and receive an auth token.

Expected: 200 OK with body { "token": "..." }
- Key response fields: token (JWT).
Error case: 409 Conflict with { "error": "Email is already registered." } when the email already exists.

List available membership plans. Requires an authenticated token.

Expected: 200 OK with body [ { "id": 1, "name": "Monthly", "durationMonths": 1, "price": 30, "maxMonthlyBookings": 8 }, ... ]
- Key response fields: id, name, durationMonths, price, maxMonthlyBookings.

Create a subscription for a member (payment handled separately). Roles: Member or Receptionist.

Expected: 201 Created with body containing the subscription.
- Key response fields: id, memberId, planId, status (Active), startDate, endDate.

Get the active subscription for a member (memberId = 1 here). Requires authentication.

Expected: 200 OK with the subscription body.
- Key response fields: id, memberId, planId, status, startDate, endDate.
Error case: 404 Not Found when the member has no active subscription.

Record a successful payment and activate the linked subscription. Roles: Receptionist or Member.

Expected: 201 Created with body containing the payment.
- Key response fields: id, subscriptionId, amount, method, status (after success the subscription becomes Active).
Error case: 404 Not Found with { "error": "Subscription not found." } when the subscription id is unknown.

Book a class for the current member (member id fixed to 1 in this course version). Role: Member. Requires an active subscription.

Expected: 201 Created with body containing the booking.
- Key response fields: id, memberId, classId, status (Booked), bookedAt.
Error cases:
- 403 Forbidden with { "error": "ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED" } when no active subscription.
- 409 Conflict with { "error": "CLASS_FULL" } or { "error": "SCHEDULE_CONFLICT" }.
- 404 Not Found when the class does not exist.

Cancel a booking by id (id = 1 here). Requires authentication.

Expected: 200 OK when the booking is cancelled.
Error case: 404 Not Found when the booking id does not exist.

Record a member check-in for a class. Role: Trainer.

Expected: 201 Created with body containing the attendance record.
- Key response fields: id, memberId, classId, status (Present), checkedInAt.
Error case: 409 Conflict with { "error": "Member is already checked in for this class." } on a duplicate check-in.
